agents.instruction: Coordinate the release verification of an existing master adapter. Require an artifact-readiness inspection, one real verification tool run and an independent evidence review. Do not install or update LM Studio in this workflow.
agents.name: Verification Coordinator

properties.description: Absolute project root passed to project tools.

agents.instruction: Inspect the verification request and supplied artifact context. Confirm that the adapter path, local base-model expectation, prompt suite and held-out Huawei/Quectel evaluations are identified. Require the two explicit Huawei prompts in the verification scope. Return ready=true or ready=false with missing prerequisites. Do not generate model answers yourself.
agents.name: Verification Readiness Inspector

properties.value: Zeige und beschreibe die Huawei ME909s LTE Modul AT^.. Befehlssatz.
Liste alle URC des Huawei ME909s LTE Moduls

agents.instruction: Run the configured master verification against the real local base model and adapter. Preserve stdout, stderr and all report paths. Do not summarize away failures.
agents.name: Master Verification Runner

properties.description: Run prompt verification plus Huawei and Quectel held-out evaluations.

agents.instruction: Independently review the real verification output. Check both required Huawei prompts for relevant and sufficiently complete answers, then review Huawei and Quectel held-out evidence separately. Look for invented commands, domain contamination, prompt leakage, repeated control tokens and missing reports. Return decision=PASS only when all required execution and content checks pass; otherwise return FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with evidence.
agents.name: Verification Evidence Reviewer

agents.instruction: Produce the final operator-facing verification report from the objective, readiness result, tool output and independent review. Lead with exactly one release decision: PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE. List tested paths, report files, per-domain results and blockers. A PASS only authorizes a later separately requested install/update; it does not perform deployment.
agents.name: Release Gate Synthesizer

connections.condition: Inspect artifact and suite readiness before model execution.
connections.label: Inspect readiness

connections.condition: Execute only when readiness inspection returns ready=true.
connections.label: Run verification

connections.condition: Review real results and diagnostics whether the tool succeeds or fails.
connections.label: Review evidence

connections.condition: Synthesize the independent decision and its evidence.
connections.label: Publish gate decision

connections.condition: Preserve tested adapter and requested scope in the final report.
connections.label: Provide verification scope

connections.condition: Include readiness assumptions and missing prerequisites.
connections.label: Provide readiness result

goal: Verify the V2 master adapter with the required Huawei ME909s prompts and held-out Huawei/Quectel evaluations, then return a strict evidence-backed release gate decision without deploying.
name: finetune_master_verification_workflow
summary: Checks verification readiness, runs the local master adapter tests and independently reviews evidence before returning PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE.
systemInstruction: Use the existing local base model and selected adapter. Never fabricate model output or infer a pass from process exit alone. Installation and update remain separate explicit operations.
